name: Golden Path — Document Intelligence Chain
description: Vectorize -> classify -> summarize -> claims -> 7Q -> contradiction -> grade -> compose -> export. One document in, full passport out.
author: David Lowe + Opus (opus-forge)
gate_rule: PASS/WARN/BLOCK per station on the regression corpus. Chain never grows past a red gate.

services_required.nlp_api: http://localhost:8700 (embed, summarize, classify, contradiction, vector store)

workflow.name: plant_boot
workflow.description: Services up + station census. Run before every batch.

workflow.name: vectorize
workflow.description: Embed doc, ingest to 8700 vector store, return vector_id.
workflow.note: Currently wired to dead Infinity 192.168.1.177:7997 — rewire to localhost:8700.

workflow.name: classify
workflow.description: Passport: doc_type, classification, tags (27 families), spine domains (6), dependency_chain, reading_level.
workflow.note: Passport embedding field is a keyword FALLBACK — carry step-1 vector_id instead, never the inline fake.

workflow.name: summarize
workflow.description: Three-tier: sentence / paragraph / executive (3-4 paras). Emits .summary.json + .summary.md.
workflow.note: BART condensation, not academic prose. Publication-grade exec summaries -> api_call LLM station later.

workflow.name: extract_claims
workflow.description: Claim list feeds 7Q and contradiction. Stage-2 of dependency map.

workflow.name: proof_grade
workflow.description: Semantic fruit/anti-fruit anchor scores on raw text.
workflow.note: Config key paper_grader_lexicon_xlsx must stay BOM-less JSON; lexicon at \\192.168.2.50\h_hp\Desktop\Master EXCEL\lexicons_master_enhanced.xlsx.

workflow.name: compose
workflow.description: Pure aggregation of steps 1-7 into the passport (ST_050).

workflow.name: export
workflow.description: Excel/HTML/vault export of the composed passport.

parallelizable: steps 1, 3, 7 are independent of each other (all read raw text); 4->5 and 4->6 are serial on claims
loop_protocol: Wire/gate ONE station per session. Run ALL gated stations on the regression corpus each session. Advance only on green.

approval_rules.auto_approve: station artifact validates against schema AND no errors[]
approval_rules.flag_review: chunks_skipped > 30% (summarizer) OR classification confidence heuristics missing
